question: {If } x > 1 { and } x² + (1)/(x²) = 83, { then } x³ - (1)/(x³) { is:}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x² + 1/x² = k, then x − 1/x = √(k − 2).

Here, k = 83, so x − 1/x = √(83 − 2) = √81 = 9.

If x − 1/x = a, then x³ − 1/x³ = a³ + 3a.

So, x³ − 1/x³ = 9³ + 3 × 9 = 729 + 27 = 756.

**∴ The correct answer is 756.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

x² + 1/x² = 83, where x > 1

**Formula Used:**

(a − b)² = a² + b² − 2ab

a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + b² + ab)

**Calculations:**

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = x² + 1/x² − 2(x)(1/x)

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 83 − 2

⇒ (x − 1/x)² = 81

⇒ x − 1/x = ±9

⇒ Since x > 1, x − 1/x must be positive, so x − 1/x = 9

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)(x² + 1/x² + 1)

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 9 × (83 + 1)

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 9 × 84

⇒ x³ − 1/x³ = 756

**∴ The correct answer is 756.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Reciprocal Identities

If x + 1/x = p, then x² + 1/x² = p² − 2 and x³ + 1/x³ = p³ − 3p.

Negative Reciprocal Identities

If x − 1/x = p, then x² + 1/x² = p² + 2 and x³ − 1/x³ = p³ + 3p.

Cube Factorization

The difference of cubes formula is a³ − b³ = (a − b)(a² + b² + ab). Substituting 1/x for b gives the identity x³ − 1/x³ = (x − 1/x)(x² + 1/x² + 1).
